rv.q: I think this production needed higher stakes and more emotional intensity throughout.
Its provocative, compelling structure is mesmerizing and the performances (especially Pryor's) are intricate and memorable. It is not to be missed.
It's no leap to say that this is one show worth checking out.
Shattered Globe Theatre's latest offering unveils a lovely, soulful story about hope and healing and so much more.
Jazzma Pryor's touching portrayal of Fay was genuinely remarkable.
Shattered Globe's Midwest premiere production, directed with kinetic flair by AmBer Montgomery, explores these themes in authentic, moving and often-surprising ways.
Still, 'Jump' is a good theater experience.

Alan Bresloff 2 years ago *** “Jump” is a sobering play about wrestling with thoughts of suicide. We see how each character is obsessed with death in their own way and how each one entertains the likely or remote possibility of ending their own life or thinking about loved ones who might choose to do so.
